requirement_text.REQ-064: Execute Decision 0006's D2: drop tenant_id from the ten schema-isolated business tables. Approved design (PASS on first gate pass, all 4 flagged corrections independently re-verified): lib/letflow/design/req064-drop-tenant-id.md.

task.description:
Implement lib/letflow/design/req064-drop-tenant-id.md in full. Read the design doc in full before writing any code -- it went through one clean gate pass with 4 specific corrections to the original requirement text independently re-verified, so implement exactly what it specifies, not the requirement text's now-superseded module names/call-site counts.

Key points from the design (do not deviate without flagging why in your handoff):
- Letflow.Engine.TokenRecord (not Engine.Token, which is REQ-044's separate in-memory struct) owns the tokens table's tenant_id field.
- 14 tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 call sites across definitions.ex/event_store.ex/promotion_review_store.ex, each with its own per-site decision in the design -- two definitions.ex sites (activate/2, rollback_definition_version/4) are explicitly LEFT UNCHANGED because tenant_id there feeds a real service-scope/permission-checker consumer, not column-stamping. Do not touch those two.
- A third users index (index(:users, [:tenant_id, :status, :inserted_at])) gets dropped with no replacement per the design's §7.2 open-question resolution (confirmed safe by the design gate -- no query filters on status+inserted_at within a tenant schema).
- Two composite indexes simplify with the idempotency contract restated in the new migration's header (promotion_reviews, promotion_assertion_runs).
- Moduledoc updates needed on more modules than the original requirement text named: Engine.Task, Engine.TokenRecord, Identity.User, Identity.Group, and all three EventStore schema modules (Event, ArchivedEvent, InstanceProjection) -- each currently has tenant_id-describing prose that must be corrected, not left stale.
- Do NOT delete TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 itself -- only its now-unneeded stamping call sites.
- Do NOT touch the four D3 tables (tenant_schemas, solution_pack_installs, solution_pack_artefact_bases, pack_update_resolutions) -- tenant_id there is a real FK, out of scope.

Self-review checklist (WF-02 §2a, plus this run's own specifics):
- mix compile --warnings-as-errors must exit 0
- mix ecto.migrate applies cleanly against a real/Docker Postgres for the new drop-tenant_id migration(s), applied against at least one real provisioned tenant schema
- Every one of the 10 schema modules' tenant_id field/cast/validate_required entries removed per the design's confirmed module list (TokenRecord, not Token)
- The two definitions.ex call sites left unchanged compile correctly and still function (their consumers -- run_service_scope_validator/3, the permission_checker -- are untouched)
- Moduledoc text updated on every module the design names, not just the two the original requirement text named
- No SQL string interpolation of tenant/user input (INV-7) in the new migration
acceptance_criteria: All migrations apply cleanly against a fresh DB via mix ecto.migrate
None of the ten confirmed tables has a tenant_id column after migration, verified against information_schema.columns in a real provisioned tenant schema
The four D3 tables retain tenant_id with their FK intact, untouched
The two composite indexes are simplified per the design, with the idempotency contract preserved
The two definitions.ex call sites (activate/2, rollback_definition_version/4) are unchanged and still compile/function
Every moduledoc the design names is updated, not left describing a removed field
